authored_by: claude-sonnet subagent, blind to router term lists (agent-authored; disclosed bias; small n)
authoring_note: AI-authored by a single agent with small n (50 items), so it carries that author's phrasing bias. Labels are the author's intended label, not independently adjudicated. Results are directional, not statistically conclusive.
scope: Published evidence (2023-2026) on AI coding assistants, AI-assisted software development and developer productivity.
